end_platform_zero_arrival.title: Ending 1: The Hidden Grid
end_platform_zero_arrival.epilogue: You step out onto Platform Zero into dense white fog. A subterranean operations hub blinks alive before you. You have uncovered the city's covert emergency transit network.

end_emergency_override.title: Ending 2: Daylight Escape
end_emergency_override.epilogue: You pull the pneumatic bypass key. Sparks fly, the emergency brakes engage with a deafening screech, and the train shunts back onto Line 3, rolling safely into daylight.
